content:
When you have a nosebleed, the best practice is to lean forward and breathe through your mouth. This position helps prevent blood from running down the back of your throat, which can cause choking or vomiting. Tilting your head back (Option A) is not recommended because it can cause blood to flow down your throat. Lying down (Option C) is also not advised because it can increase blood pressure in the head and worsen the bleeding.

Answer: B
